sv.title: Krimbron uppges skadad efter ukrainska attacker
sv.summary: Bron som förbinder ryskockuperade Krim med fastlandet uppges ha skadats efter flera ukrainska attacker. Bilder påstås visa hur delar av bron har kollapsat. Ryska myndigheter uppger att de öppnat en terrorismutredning, enligt Reuters.

en.title: Crimean bridge reportedly damaged after Ukrainian attacks
en.summary: The bridge connecting Russian-occupied Crimea with the mainland is reportedly damaged after several Ukrainian attacks. Images allegedly show parts of the bridge collapsing. Russian authorities say they have opened a terrorism investigation, according to Reuters.
